meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill for omo-senpi. Self-orchestrates a 5-member hostile team (categories unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via the native lead team tools for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the insights that survive the attacks, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled bundle to a planner task (load_skills ulw-plan) for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用对抗式辩论打磨规划方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果您的规划需要暴露隐藏的弱点并提升严谨性
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your planning needs rigorous critique to surface hidden flaws

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会扮演 5 人对抗团队的 Lead,成员互相狠批彼此观点;它把经得起攻击的想法交给规划任务整理成可执行方案。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”“hpp”“adversarial plan”等触发词,或提需求并希望规划必须极其严谨时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 规划新功能上线方案。
say.note: 触发敌对团队辩论并产出最终方案。

say.text: hpp:帮我挑出这个计划里的薄弱假设。
say.note: 让团队攻击现有计划,暴露弱点。

say.text: adversarial plan:评估模块改动的风险。
say.note: 触发团队交叉批评,过滤出经得起攻击的观点。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as Lead of a 5-member hostile team; members ruthlessly critique each other's findings. It keeps only the insights that survive, then passes them to a planner task for executable plan formalization.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', etc., or ask for planning with maximum rigor.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan the new feature launch.
say_en.note: Starts hostile debate and outputs the final plan.

say_en.text: hpp: find weak assumptions in this plan.
say_en.note: The team attacks the plan and exposes flaws.

say_en.text: adversarial plan: assess risks of the module change.
say_en.note: Triggers cross-critique, filtering for surviving insights.
